title: Vast hero
description: A full-window opening: a photo or looping video fills the screen edge to edge, with a huge, tightly tracked white headline (76px on desktop, 48px on phones) sitting bottom-left. The headline words rise in one after another on load; the media drifts down slowly as you scroll past, so it seems to lag behind.
notes: exactly one window tall (100svh); the media is cropped like object-fit: cover
white text sits straight on the media (highlight-foreground), so use a darker or busy photo, or add your own scrim in the media slot
pairs with the fixed vastspace-header, which floats over the top of it
empty media shows a flat moon-rock placeholder
